Soft pieces

Mild paprika stew

Babavadas

8 months+ Replaced 40 min 4 portions

Mash the stew or offer soft pieces. Freeze it without the yogurt, then stir the yogurt in after reheating and cooling.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 small onion (finely chopped)
  • 1 medium carrot (diced small)
  • 1 small parsnip (diced small)
  • 150 g sweet potato (peeled and diced)
  • 150 g boneless chicken or rabbit (diced small)
  • 1 tsp mild paprika (not hot)
  • 2 tbsp plain yogurt (pasteurized, stirred in off the heat)
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 200 ml water (plain)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Soften the onion in the oil, then stir in the paprika.
  2. Add the chicken or rabbit, carrot, parsnip, and sweet potato.
  3. Pour in the water and simmer until the meat and vegetables are very soft, with no mustard, vinegar, or bay leaf.
  4. Shred the meat and check it for bone or gristle.
  5. Take the pan off the heat, stir in the yogurt, and mash or chop the stew.

Replaced

The usual stew used mustard, vinegar, and sour cream. Mustard is harsh and salty for this age, and vinegar is too sharp.

Mustard was dropped. This version is a mild paprika stew of carrot, parsnip, sweet potato, onion, and chicken or rabbit, with the bay leaf left out and plain yogurt stirred in at the end.
